summary: Implemented and independently reviewed the GitHub scoring/review bot, Gemini HIGH review, pinned HF proposer panel, read-only HF leaderboard Space and two narrow engine fixes on github-app. Real Linux CI scored a private PR; the App posted one updating summary, a correct regression failure and a validated Gemini line comment. Real engine output also produced a request consumed by Qwen through HF. Source is committed locally, not pushed; public hosting, verifier/loop, platform import and full Linux test gates remain incomplete.
